intent.text: There is striking alignment across all four vantages: every member moved that one independent reviewer from another model family should be the baseline check, with councils reserved for escalation (unresolved deadlocks or high-stakes irreversible work). Key enrichments from indep and plan should be incorporated: charging the reviewer with specific actionable checks (dependencies, unstated assumptions, verification test validity) rather than subjective grading, and unanchored review where the reviewer writes findings before seeing author rationales. I welcome an amendment synthesizing these operational details into the pending motion.
